name: Pick up disc
description: The player picks up a disc, after a pull or turnover.

name: Intercept
description: The player intercepts a pass. The player catches the disc and gain possession

name: Block
description: The player blocks a pass, either when marking the thrower or when defending a cut.

name: Score
description: The player scores a point. This includes Callahan points.

name: Pull
description: The disc is thrown to the other team at the start of a point.

name: Defense
description: A defensive play that results in a change of possession.
